component-o.description-s: SMD tactile switch 4.5 x 4.5 mm, 4.0 mm tall, top actuated, 4 gull-wing pins (1-2 and 3-4 internally connected), SPST-NO, 12 VDC 50 mA, 250 gf

non-technical-o.stock-note-s: LCSC C52092029, 36252 in stock (pcbparts jlc_stock_check 2026-10-21); not carried by DigiKey

source-o.table-s: 电气性能 (electrical): rating DC12V/50mA; contact resistance <= 100 mOhm; insulation >= 100 MOhm; withstand AC250V/min; force 250+/-50 g; life 100,000; height 4.0+/-0.1 mm; circuit diagram 1-2 / 3-4

component-o.footprint_check-s: PCB线路板图 (p1): 4 pads 1 x 0.7 mm on a 7.0 x 3.0 mm grid; board pads 1.4 x 0.8 at (+/-3.5, +/-1.5) -- same grid, pins 1/2 share a row and net (+BATT), 3/4 the other (B1 +)

not_stated-o.operating-force-n-x100-i: stated as 250+/-50 gf; 245 is the gf->N conversion
